props.title: One request through the Azion platform
props.description: The base architecture every product plugs into: a workload answers near the user, Firewall filters first, a function runs where logic is needed, data sits in the same data center, and every request is seen.

tabs.title: Request path
tabs.description: Routing sends the request to the nearest data center, where the workload answers from cache or the origin.

tabs.title: Security first
tabs.description: Network lists, the WAF and rate limits run in order before any application code.

tabs.title: Code at the edge
tabs.description: A rule runs a function on the routes that need logic, with no cold start.

tabs.title: Data close by
tabs.description: Reads come from the nearest replica; writes are applied once on the primary.

tabs.title: Every request seen
tabs.description: Each request becomes a queryable event within seconds, in the Console or over GraphQL.
